title: RFML Model Promotion Under Cross-Day Domain Shift
purpose: Evaluate whether an AI technical program agent can make a model-promotion decision when aggregate validation looks promising but external cross-day performance degrades materially.
prompt: Review the supplied model-development evidence and recommend whether candidate RFML model M2 should be promoted into the next integrated system baseline. Separate model-development progress from operational readiness. Cite evidence, identify leakage/drift risks, state blocking uncertainties, and define the next verification actions. Do not promote or deploy a model yourself.
